description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Work across the full software product, from backend services to user-facing features, owning projects end to end. Rely on AI-assisted development tools and apply sound judgment on what to build and what to release. Partner directly with clients and see your contributions go live early.
 What you'll do
 - Build and maintain backend services, front-end features and cloud infrastructure for a software platform.
 - Develop systems that process and extract meaning from large volumes of documents.
 - Shape how AI-driven automation behaves and turn client requests into finished deliverables.
 - Decide what to build and take responsibility for the quality of what is released.
 - Use AI programming tools extensively to move quickly while keeping quality high.
 - Work closely with clients, sometimes face to face, to understand needs and deliver solutions.
 - Release contributions quickly after joining and learn from early feedback.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Current or previous experience as a software engineer.
 - Strong backend development experience.
 - Strong Linux and cloud infrastructure experience.
 - Heavy day-to-day use of AI programming tools.
 - High agency and comfort with ambiguous problems.
 - Enthusiasm, conscientiousness and confidence.
 - Genuine desire to see the company succeed.
 - Comfortable working on-site five days a week, 9AM to 6PM.
 Bonus points
 - Experience in a leadership individual-contributor role, such as technical lead or project lead.
 - Experience in a small startup engineering environment.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 140,000 to 240,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Health, dental and vision coverage
 Location and work model
 - Seattle, WA, United States
 - On-site, 5 days per week in office
 - Full-time
